records.title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth
records.reason: This paper studies safe recurrent test-time depth on small algorithmic tasks and checks consistency on Huginn-3.5B. It offers a potential basis for deciding when to stop loops, but does not demonstrate reduced inference compute at matched quality on general serving workloads.

records.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets
records.reason: The retrofit adds a recurrent block to Qwen2.5-0.5B and reports accuracy/depth results on controlled tasks. Its limitations explicitly say inference compute, FLOPs, and latency are not matched; additional loops may raise cost, so direct serving efficiency is unresolved.

records.title: Not All LLM Reasoning is Visible in the Chain-of-Thought
records.reason: Studies hidden reasoning/filler tokens and safety monitoring, not an efficiency method.

records.title: When Does Recurrence Become an Algorithm? Convergence Selection in Weight-Tied Looped Transformers
records.reason: Primary text limits its claims to weight-tied loops on algorithmic sequence tasks at ≤25M parameters and explicitly leaves pretrained depth-recurrent LMs out of scope; it provides no applicable LLM serving result.

records.title: Dense Supervision Is Not Enough: The Readout Blind Spot in Looped Language Models
records.reason: This work diagnoses hidden-state scale growth in 44M/129M looped LMs and proposes scale-visible readouts/penalties or scale-removing recurrence. It is primarily a training/stability analysis and reports no direct serving throughput or latency benefit.
